notes: Letter A-Z and number badges now use a true circular background.
Numbers reduced to 1-9, the range that is actually used for steps, benefits and the nine image set. Any other number can be typed into a badge.
Overlapping stickers, text and markers: tapping the same spot again cycles to the layer underneath, so everything is reachable.
Small layers now keep a minimum touch area, so shrunken stickers stay easy to grab.
Rotation is safer: tapping the rotate handle resets the angle to 0, and holding it for about a second starts rotating.
